scope: Replay the empirical notebook Ridge(alpha=1) with reference U; compare to Table 1 parenthesized 4.063. This is an author-procedure result, not a public GraphFLA OLS paper-result claim.
preprocessing: All 197890 rows of bundled Kuo2020.csv, 9 RNA positions, stored log(GFP) values unchanged. Explicit reference U and A checked separately; three nonreference indicators per position, Ridge(alpha=1) with intercept, denominator 27. A local algebraic replay uses sklearn Ridge, without executing downloaded notebook code. No missing-state imputation, RNG, graph filtering, or extrapolation.

sources.locator: Table 1 Kuo et al. 2020 r/s parenthesized value 4.063; this is average-measurement ruggedness, not extrapolated 3.965.
cal_r_s uses Ridge and mean absolute retained coefficients; input coding load_sequence uses ATCG. Supplied Methods formula differs.

comparison.justification: Half a unit in the last printed decimal.
